facts.summary: Phase 2b missed primary pain endpoint overall; later-enrolled subgroup positive · Phase 2 · IMC-1 in fibromyalgia · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Overall, the FORTRESS study did not achieve statistical significance on the prespecified primary efficacy endpoint of change from baseline to Week 14 in the weekly average of daily self-reported average pain severity scores
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Overall, the FORTRESS study did not achieve statistical significance on the prespecified primary efficacy endpoint of change from baseline to Week 14 in the weekly average of daily self-reported average pain severity scores comparing IMC-1 to placebo (p=0.302).
evidence.safety: IMC-1 was well-tolerated overall, with only 4.6% of IMC-1 treated patients dropping out due to adverse events, as compared with 8.1% of placebo treated patients.
evidence.program_discontinued: We will continue to explore IMC-1’s potential as a viable FM treatment option.
